claims.statement: The MDR requires reporting statistically significant increases in specified incident frequency or severity.
Four EUDAMED modules became mandatory on 28 May 2026 while vigilance and post-market surveillance remained under development.

contrary_evidence: Established quality platforms and consultancies already serve manufacturers.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: ISO consultants and authorized representatives.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 150 manufacturers at 60000 PLN annually yield 9 million PLN revenue and founder equity above 5 million PLN in six years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: 12-18 hours weekly with regulatory specialists.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: six months on an annual contract.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 3000-15000 PLN monthly plus 100-400 PLN per escalation.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: recurring complaints and audit history retain clients.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Resolved labels improve triage and embedded audit history raises switching costs
fingerprint.customer: CEE device manufacturers and authorized representatives
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Signal normalization, trend analytics, and human-review queues
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The manufacturer pays monthly and per specialist escalation
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A complaint must enter surveillance and possible vigilance review

founder_fit: Health interest and anomaly detection align while regulated judgment stays external.
risks: A missed serious incident creates patient-safety exposure.

structure.control_point: A multilingual incident taxonomy linked to regulatory dispositions and corrective actions
structure.critical_dependency: Complaint access and continuous qualified-person review

thesis: A multilingual medical-device complaint and trend utility serves CEE manufacturers while qualified humans retain all reportability decisions.
title: Vigilance Signal Desk
uncertainties: Complaint volume and outsourcing appetite are unknown.
